issues.issue: Is the claimant at risk from FARC because of his anti-FARC campaigning?
issues.applicant_position: FARC threatened, shot at and abducted him for opposing its university infiltration.
issues.result_text: Court has little reason to disbelieve evidence of active opposition to FARC leading to persecution.

issues.issue: Is adequate state protection available to the claimant if he returns to Colombia?
issues.applicant_position: Problem is whether protection would work; cannot say for sure he would receive it.
issues.result_text: Adequate state protection is available, given the formidable protection after his 2007 return.

issues.issue: Does the claimant face a serious possibility of persecution or risk under sections 96 and 97(1)?
issues.applicant_position: Fears FARC persecution, risk to life and cruel treatment if returned to Colombia.
issues.result_text: State protection is adequate, so no serious possibility of persecution or s.97 risk; claim rejected.
